messages:
Anya (PM): quick sync 1: decision needed on cushioned eviction defaults for dedicated pools before next roadmap review.
Rohit (Eng): propose default cushion_pct=10, hard_evict_threshold=3. two-step reclaim reduces churn.
Marta (SRE): ops wants a 30s reclaim window and telemetry: cushion_used_pct, reclaim_count, hard_evicts, migrate_failures.
Ben (Legal): legal requires opt-out in contracts and a 24h notice for scheduled hard evictions; emergency evict allowed with incident log.
Ivy (ProdOps): UX: show "Burst cushion" with percent and "Eviction mode" (graceful|immediate). default = graceful.
Rohit (Eng): config sketch:
```
reserved_pools:
  cushion_pct: 10
  hard_evict_threshold_pct: 3
  reclaim_wait_seconds: 30
  eviction_mode: graceful
```
Marta (SRE): Pilot plan: canary pool -> 3 customers (EU latency, US bursty, APAC dev). Alerts on migrate_fail_rate > 1%.
Anya (PM): action items: Rohit RFC + defaults, Marta runbook + dashboards, Ben contract blurb, Ivy pilot recruitment. evict-bot: create CAP-4201.
evict-bot: created CAP-4201 assigned to @Rohit.
Anya (PM): meeting done  drop blockers here or DM me.
